notes.title: Season 1 Launch Patch Notes — Stellar Rhythm
notes.content:
Dear Rogueteers,

Thank you for charging through S0: Ground Zero with us. Your feedback, clutch saves, and endless theory-crafting set the stage for our first full Season. The beat now drops with S1: Stellar Rhythm—a fresh world, a new Rogueteer, deeper systems, and a suite of quality-of-life upgrades to keep your runs smooth and your builds singing.

Below are the maintenance times and everything landing with the Season launch.
[hr][/hr]Downtime (NA & EU Timezones)
Season 1 begins after scheduled maintenance (~4 hours):

PDT (UTC−7): Tue, Sep 23, 7:00–11:00 PM

EDT (UTC−4): Tue, Sep 23, 10:00 PM – Wed, Sep 24, 2:00 AM

UTC: Wed, Sep 24, 02:00–06:00

BST (UTC+1): Wed, Sep 24, 03:00–07:00

CEST (UTC+2): Wed, Sep 24, 04:00–08:00

If extra time is needed, server reopening will be postponed. Thanks for your patience while we tune the servers for a smoother Season.
[hr][/hr]TL;DR
S0 ends → S1: Stellar Rhythm begins

New World: Protostar + Arbiter of Stars (mark + chain damage)

New Mode: Endless Delve (pre-pick Arbiter Perks & Keys; Core drops)

Systems: Season Talents, Bulwark/Defense Modules, refreshed trait pools

QoL: Loadout Presets, Keyword Search, smarter sorting, lock/discard at settlement

Events: Login rewards (Legendary skin), weekly missions, weekend training, limited-time draws

Skins: Immortal Trendsetter Maestro (Heat Wave) for Max; new Resplendents for Blade, Rebela, Heynckes
[hr][/hr]Season Transition
Season Switch: After maintenance, S0: Ground Zero concludes and S1: Stellar Rhythm kicks off.

Ever-verse Preservation:

Prior-season Combat Terminull move to the Ever-verse (equip-only; not craftable).

Standard Mode remains playable in the Ever-verse (all difficulties, no drops).

Progress Reset: Progress across all game modes and related data resets for S1.

Carries Into S1: Unlocked Rogueteers & Skins, Proficiency, Ability Modules, Achievements, Decoders, and store currencies (Platinum Coins, Tycho Coins, Purified Data).
Transferred to Ever-verse: Modules, Cores.
Removed at Season Start: Terminull Coins, Crystal Cores, Core Fragments, Suppression Code, Basic/Advanced Locators, Module Store Redemption Items (Faded/Charged/Overloaded Modules).
[hr][/hr]Gameplay UpdatesNew World: Protostar
Fresh enemy traits and a new seasonal combat flavor.

Arbiter of Stars replaces Arbiter of Games in Protostar—marks targets and chains damage.
New Mode: Endless Delve
Choose Arbiter Perks & Keys before combat.

Unlock: Clear Floor 10 of Corrective Action.

Rewards: Drops Cores.
Corrective Action
Adds Protostar content and new Duo Bosses on higher floors.

Breakdown Point reworked into buffs (not debuffs).

New Chaotic effects added.
Chains of Disorder
New music-themed Protostar boss fight joins the rotation.
Rotations
Seasonal mode Viral Frenzy has been removed.
[hr][/hr]Rogueteers & Weapons
New Rogueteer: Rebela — a music-driven adventurer wielding a harmonic battle-axe; confident at close and mid-range.

Heynckes – Frostfire Waltz: Obtain via Pass or Shop.

Max – One Shot to Flatten ’Em All: Earnable from the S1 launch event.
[hr][/hr]Progression & ModulesSeason Talents
New Season Talent system amps up Keys of Potential and Talent attributes.

Unlock: Clear Difficulty 5 of Standard Mode.
New Module Types
Bulwark Module: Unique single-slot Module that buffs neighboring Modules.

Defense Module: New defensive option to mitigate damage.
Trait Pool Refresh
Legendary Modules: +20 new Traits.

Immortal Modules: +14 Rogueteer-exclusive Traits, +9 Arbiter-related Traits.

Removed: S0’s Rogueteer-exclusive & Arbiter-related Traits.
[hr][/hr]「Exchange Store」
All Module redemption materials consolidated to Faded Modules; new redemptions unlock with Corrective Action progress.

Excess Code can be exchanged for Terminull Coins.
[hr][/hr]Quality of Life
Preset System: Save three Terminull presets; swap and activate anytime.

Keyword Search: Find Modules by name/ID, filter by traits & shapes.

Smarter Sorting: Prioritizes strong/limit-breaking attributes (yellow sub-attributes).

Faster Management: Lock or discard Modules directly from the settlement screen.
[hr][/hr]S1 Opening Events
S1 Launch: Log in across multiple days to claim Colonel’s Legendary Skin – Electro Burnbeat and more.

Tycho Treasure: Complete weekly missions to earn Modules.

Weekly Training (Thu–Sun): Grab Advanced Locators, First-Tune Cores, Final-Tune Cores, and more.

Stellar Rhythm – Value Gift: Spend 10+ Purified Data to unlock new Accessories; logins grant Platinum Coins and extra rewards tied to spending.

Stellar Rhythm Supply: Own designated Skins or unlock the S1 Pass to claim limited-time goodies.

Verdict of the Crimson Sky: Spend Purified Data for a chance at Heynckes’ Resplendent Skin – Verdict of the Crimson Sky (first draw is free).

More events incoming—follow our official channels for updates.
[hr][/hr]Brand-New S1 Skins
Immortal: Trendsetter Maestro (Heat Wave) — Max
Max returns from a Journey to the West-inspired odyssey, rainbow-wreathed with a radiant cloud underfoot.

Resplendent:

Mesmeric Heist (Blade)

Doomsday Sound Wave (Rebela)

Verdict of the Crimson Sky (Heynckes)
[hr][/hr]
Thanks for tuning in, syncing up, and shredding with us this Season. Your runs, feedback, and bug reports keep the Nullverse humming—please keep them coming.

See you out there, Rogueteers.
— Terminull Brigade Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – Server Maintenance & Updates (Aug 13, 2025)
notes.content:
Dear Rogueteers,
We will be conducting scheduled server maintenance on Aug 13, 00:00 (PDT) / Aug 13, 07:00 (UTC). The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours, during which time access to Terminull Brigade will be temporarily unavailable. As a token of appreciation for your patience, all Rogueteers will receive 300 Tycho Coins in the mail following the maintenance.
[hr][/hr]
\[Content Updates]

Boss HP Bars: HP bars for bosses across various difficulty levels have been adjusted to provide a more accurate representation of their remaining health.

Module Warehouse Capacity Detection: A new feature has been added to notify Rogueteers when their Warehouse is nearing capacity, allowing you to clear out space quickly and avoid unnecessary losses.

Immortal-Tier Module Drop Rate: The drop rate for Immortal-tier Modules has been increased.

Standard Mode Optimization: Perfect Clear times can now be checked at higher difficulty levels, and various rules for Standard Mode have been fine-tuned.

Legendary Skins: Descriptions for Legendary Rogueteer skins have been optimized for clarity.
[hr][/hr]
\[Bug Fixes]

In-Game Contents

Rogueteers

Gloria’s Ultimate special effects have been optimized to prevent stuttering.

Gloria's turrets will now always target the boss Wuxiang after it burrows underground.

Gloria’s Rescuebots will expire correctly after use.

Drops from Max’s Minor will no longer affect the team’s movement speed.

Fixed unintended interactions when downed Rogueteers revive using Respawn Coins.

Enemies

Malcolm, the boss, will no longer lose invulnerability while transforming.

Wuxiang’s laser attack display now lasts as long as the attack itself.

Fixed persistent laser attack sound effects for Wuxiang.

Fixed issues with certain enemies' transformation stages.

Arbiters

The Arbiter of Music’s Musical Notes can no longer penetrate obstacles.

The Arbiter of Fortune’s Lucky Weapon now applies the correct bonus.

The Fog of Desire produced by the Arbiter of Desire now deals damage to GT-6300.

Display effects for both the Arbiter of Music and Arbiter of Desire will now expire properly.

The Arbiter of Energy’s Power Up display effects now expire correctly.

Ability Module

Fixed errors in certain Ability Module descriptions.

Resolved Overload Shot-related issues in the Ability Module.

Combat Terminull

Data now displays correctly when swapping installed Cores.

Weapon Charge and Skill Charge traits now apply properly between maps.

Corrective Action

Primary Skill refresh spots now generate recovery items.

Auto-Save in Corrective Action no longer overwrites filled save slots.

Fixed stuttering caused by certain special effects.

Other Game Contents

Arbiter Anecdotes missions now track progress correctly across all game modes.

Fixed issues in the script for the main story mission Wasteland Virus Cleanup (Difficulty 7).

Other Fixes

Various translation issues have been resolved.

Sound effects in cutscenes now play at normal volume.

Fixed several game-crashing bugs.

Voice chat display errors caused by specific actions have been fixed.

Fixed overlapping Skins interface with other game interfaces.

Seasonal avatars now display properly.

Default frame rate cap settings now apply as intended.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your continued support!

The Terminull Brigade Team remains committed to improving your gaming experience. We hope you enjoy the latest updates, and we look forward to seeing you in the Nullverse!

notes.title: Server Maintenance & Compensation Update – Aug 1st, 2025
notes.content:
Dear Rogueteers,

It’s been just two days since launch, and we’ve been closely listening to your feedback. We know the limited access to Rogueteers early on wasn’t the best experience, and we sincerely apologize. This is not the Nullverse we want to build with you.

We agree that the way some Rogueteers were unlocked didn’t make the best first impression. Based on your input, we’re making some immediate changes to improve that experience.


Maintenance Details 

Terminull Brigade will undergo server maintenance on (PDT) Aug-01 12PM  / (UTC) Aug-01 7PM, lasting around 1 hour (subject to change). During this time, the game will be unavailable. After the maintenance, you will receive 300 Tycho Coins as a reward via in-game mail!

\[Main Update]
[olist]
Max, previously available through the Shop or Tycho Coins, will now be unlocked for free after completing First Entry to Ringed City.

Blade, previously unlocked by clearing difficulty 3, will now be available for free after completing First Entry to Ringed City.

Fixed the issue where the red dot on the mail icon wouldn’t disappear.

Fixed crashes related to certain graphics cards.

Fixed the loud BOSS intro CG sound effect.
[/olist]
What’s Next?
After maintenance, all players who logged in before the update will receive Max and Blade via in-game mail. If you purchased Max or unlocked Blade, here’s your compensation plan:

\[Compensation Plan]
[olist]
Max Supreme Pack Purchasers: You’ll get a refund of 120% of the original price of Max (980 Platinum Coins) in Purified Data (1176 Purified Data).

Tycho Coin Exchangers for Max: Full refund of 980 Tycho Coins.

Blade Unlockers (difficulty 3): Compensation includes Faded Module x480, Charged Module x230, and Overloaded Module x230.
[/olist]
\[Compensation Timing]
[olist]
If you purchased Max, exchanged Tycho Coins, or unlocked Blade before (PDT) Aug-01 5AM / (UTC) Aug-01 12PM, you’ll receive your compensation by (PDT) Aug-02 8:59AM / (UTC) Aug-02 3:59PM.

If you made those purchases or unlocks between (PDT) Aug-01 5AM and the start of maintenance, compensation will be sent by (PDT) Aug-03 8:59AM / (UTC) Aug-03 3:59PM.

If you miss out on compensation, please contact in-game customer support with your ID, Rogueteer name, and unlock time. To find your ID, click your avatar in the \[Game Lobby], go to \[Career], and copy your \[ID].

[/olist]
\[Looking Ahead]

The S0 season of Terminull Brigade has officially begun! We’re excited to continue improving and polishing the game with your valuable feedback. Thanks for sticking with us—we’re in this together!

See you in the Nullverse, Rogueteers!

Terminull Brigade Team

notes.title: 🧪 Final Beta Incoming: Squad Up One Last Time
notes.content:
Rogueteers,


You absolutely *rocked* the demo during Next Fest—and because of your amazing feedback, we’re rolling out one last round: the Final Beta.



This isn’t just a rehash. The Final Beta features a **fresh new build**—more polished, packed with new content, and fully playable in **co-op**. 
Whether you’ve played in past betas or this is your first drop, this version brings **the best pre-launch experience yet**.



🎮 Already joined a previous playtest?

You’re in! Your access still works—and now, for the first time, you can invite your friends directly via Steam to join the Final Beta with you. Rally your squad and explore the Nullverse together.



---

🗓 Final Beta Schedule

📥 Recruitment: June 26 – July 10

🔥 Playable: July 10 – 12

---



This is your **final chance to play before launch day (July 29)**—don’t miss it. We’re almost there, and your feedback during this beta will help make sure Terminull Brigadelands as strong as it can.



👉 **Sign up now** by hitting the \[Request Access] button on our Steam page.



Let’s finish this fight together.

See you in the Null.

notes.title: Closed Beta Incoming! Mark Your Calendars, Rogueteers!
notes.content:
Hey Rogueteers! 🎯

The moment you’ve all been waiting for is here! 
We’re thrilled to announce the dates for our Closed Beta playtest: March 22 - March 30! 🎮 
This one’s for our North America players, and it’s your chance to dive into the Nullverse of Terminull Brigade before anyone else.

Sharpen your blades, charge up your Nulls, and prepare to unleash absolute mayhem during these exclusive playtest dates. This is your chance to give us feedback, test new mechanics, and be a part of shaping the future of the game!

How to join the Closed Beta:
[olist]
1. Head over to our Steam page.
[/olist]
[olist]
2. Click the Request Access button to sign up for the beta.
[/olist]
[olist]
3. Keep an eye on your inbox—Steam will send a notification email if you’re selected for access.
[/olist]
[olist]
4. Once accepted, Terminull Brigade will automatically appear in your Steam library, ready to download and play during the test window!
[/olist]

Don’t miss out on this chance to help shape the future of the game! We can’t wait to see you on the battlefield. 💥

notes.title: Join Terminull Brigade's Alpha Test
notes.content:
Hey Rogueteers!

We’re thrilled to finally share something we’ve been cooking up in the Unreal Engine kitchen for over two years—Terminull Brigade is almost ready for you!

Terminull Brigade is a fast-paced, co-op action-roguelike hero-shooter still in its early stages of development, and we couldn’t be more excited for you to check it out. 

Why a Shooter-Roguelike hybrid?

Passion
We blend shooter and roguelike elements out of genuine passion. As fans of both genres, we’re driven by:

 The high-energy and nonstop action of shooters.
 The endless depth and replayability of roguelikes.
 This combination enhances the strengths of both, promising a uniquely thrilling experience.

Expertise
With over a decade of shooter development experience and a strong grasp of roguelike mechanics, our team is primed to deliver something special.  We’re confident that Terminull Brigade will exceed the expectations of both shooter and roguelike fans.


Why co-op gameplay?

 Explore Together: Dive into the NullVerse with friends, facing exciting challenges together.
 Dynamic Character & Skills: Combine character builds and unique skills to boost team performance.
 Item Swaping: Swap items with teammates to optimize strategies.
 Enhanced Roguelike Randomness: Enjoy the unpredictable thrill of roguelike gameplay, made even more exciting by teamwork.

------
Perhaps you took part in our early closed pre-alpha back in October, when we were using the code name Project Rogueteers (sound familiar?)

But if you missed out, don’t worry! We’ve got you covered. 
We’re hosting a brand-new Alpha playtest from December 16th to 20th, and we’d love for you to jump in!

Click on the link below and fill out the quick sign-up form to secure your spot in the Alpha playtest: 

Alpha sign-up

Can’t wait to see you in the Nullverse, Rogueteer!

P.S
Don't forget to wishlist & join our Discord community! 

We'll keep you updated on our progress as we work together to create a better Terminull Brigade for everyone!

Cheers,
The Pew Pew Games Team
